Mexico loses Mora to ankle injury-Xinhua - 新华网 MEXICO CITY, Oct. 5 (Xinhua) -- Teenage midfielder Gilberto Mora will miss Mexico's friendly against Chile due to injury, the Mexican Football Federation (FMF) said on Monday. Mora suffered an ankle injury in Mexico's 1-1 draw with Colombia on Sept. 26 and subsequently missed Mexico's friendlies against Peru and the United States.
